source.title: Larne Times, 18 January 1930, p. 8 ("Ballyclare News")
source.publisher: Larne Times (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: 'There were no nominations received by the Town Clerk... for three vacant seats on the Ballyclare Urban Council, and the two retiring members, Messrs. S. Beattie and S. Douther were re-elected. At the annual meeting, there will be a third councillor co-opted.'

note: Annual election of one-third of the Ballyclare Urban Council, January 1930. No nominations were lodged for three vacant seats; the two retiring members were re-elected and a third councillor was to be co-opted (Larne Times, 18 January 1930, p. 8). Two of the three retiring seats filled; the third was left to co-option. Returned unopposed.
